nodes.title: Define API contract and hand-off documentation for tool suggestions
nodes.summary: Before any UI work is finalized, specify the new backend endpoints the feature needs: submit a tool suggestion (authenticated user, free-text description), and list, view and update the status of suggestions for admin users. Document request and response schemas, validation rules (required description, length limits), auth and role requirements, error responses, and the data model (id, description, submitter, created timestamp, status). Package this as a standalone document the API Agent can act on, and include mock or stub response shapes so the frontend can be built in parallel.

nodes.title: Fix the build failure caused by the unresolved ToolSuggestionModal import
nodes.summary: The production build fails with UNLOADABLE_DEPENDENCY because src/components/shell/GlobalToolbar.tsx imports ToolSuggestionModal from "@/components/shell/ToolSuggestionModal", a path that does not exist. The modal lives at src/components/tools/ToolSuggestionModal.tsx. Correct the import path in GlobalToolbar.tsx (or relocate the file, but keep a single canonical location), and check every other reference to the modal, including the toolbar and modal tests and any docs or README mentions, so they all point to the same place. Verify by running a clean build and confirming the toolbar renders and the suggestion modal opens from the context menu.

nodes.summary: `npm i` warns that `@tanstack/react-start` and its related packages require Node >=22.12.0, while the local environment runs Node 20.20.2. The new CI workflow uses Node 22, so local and CI environments can produce different results, such as the generated route tree output. Add an `engines` field and an `.nvmrc` (or equivalent) at Node 22, document the requirement in the README and AGENTS.md, and confirm a clean install and `npm run verify` on Node 22.

nodes.title: Admin view for reviewing submitted tool suggestions
nodes.summary: Provide an admin-only view where suggestions saved by users can be listed, opened and processed further. Show the description, submitter and date, support basic status handling (e.g. new, reviewed, accepted, rejected) as defined in the API contract, and enforce role-based access so non-admin users cannot see the view or its navigation entry. Include empty, loading and error states and tests for the permission checks.

nodes.title: Tidy the dev-server, build output and generated-file hygiene
nodes.summary: Local runs show three loose ends. `vite dev` silently moves to port 3001 when 3000 is taken, which can confuse the documented LAN URLs. The build writes `.output` and `node_modules/.nitro` and rewrites tracked generated files. Confirm `.gitignore`, `.prettierignore` and the ESLint ignores cover `.output`, `.routes-check-tmp` and `.vite`, and remove the tracked `.vite/deps` files. Also consider running Prettier on `src/routeTree.gen.ts` or excluding it from formatting so codegen output and committed output cannot drift apart.
